name: Portal Jump
description: In a dark underpass a glowing portal tears open and the subject steps through into a sunlit jungle.

wardrobe.man: an olive field jacket, a black t-shirt, cargo trousers and boots
wardrobe.woman: an olive field jacket, a black t-shirt, cargo trousers and boots
wardrobe.person: an olive field jacket, a black t-shirt, cargo trousers and boots

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} stands in a dark concrete underpass at night, seen from behind at a slight three-quarter angle, facing the far end of the tunnel, wearing {wardrobe}. Wet concrete walls, a few flickering sodium lights, puddles on the ground and darkness ahead. Medium-wide shot from behind at shoulder height, the {subject} on the left third, the dark tunnel ahead in the center. Cinematic night photography, dim orange sodium light, deep shadows, wet reflections. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, bare concrete walls throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands in the underpass facing the dark tunnel. A ring of swirling golden sparks tears open in the air two metres ahead of {them}, widening into a tall glowing portal, and through it a bright sunlit jungle is visible, green leaves and warm light spilling into the dark tunnel and onto the wet ground. The {subject} walks forward and steps through the portal into the jungle, and the camera follows right behind {them} through the ring, so that by the last second the frame is filled with dense green jungle in golden sunlight. Sound: an electric crackle as the portal opens, a deep whoosh, jungle birds and insects growing louder. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, a swirling spark portal with real light spill, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame carries on with the same action. A ring of swirling golden sparks tears open in the air in front of {them}, widening into a tall glowing portal with a bright sunlit jungle visible through it, warm green light spilling out onto the {subject} and everything around {them}. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: an electric crackle as the portal opens, a deep whoosh, distant jungle birds. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, a swirling spark portal with real light spill, sharp detail, stable picture.
